name: Measuring what people do in the product

failureModes.prompt: Should analytics events be allowed to include what people wrote, said or uploaded?
failureModes.why: anything sent to an analytics service is copied to another company, and it is hard to find and delete there later

options.label: Never, only counts and categories
options.consequence: less detail to explore, and private words never leave the product

options.label: Include content when it helps analysis
options.consequence: richer analysis, and private words are stored by another company

failureModes.provenBy: a test that records each event the app sends and asserts no event property holds free text, audio or file contents

failureModes.prompt: Should tracking wait until people agree to it, in the places where the law requires that?
failureModes.why: consent cannot be collected afterwards for activity already recorded, and EU rules require it before non-essential tracking on a person's device

options.label: Ask first where the law requires it
options.consequence: fewer people counted in those places, and no tracking without permission

options.label: Track everyone from the first screen
options.consequence: complete numbers, and a breach of consent rules in places such as the EU

failureModes.recommended: Ask first where the law requires it
failureModes.provenBy: a test that starts the product without consent and asserts no tracking request leaves the device until consent is given

failureModes.prompt: Should we agree on one main number for success before adding any tracking?
failureModes.why: activity that was never recorded cannot be recovered, so the question has to come before the tracking

options.label: One agreed number first
options.consequence: tracking is built around it, and other numbers stay secondary

options.label: Track everything, decide later
options.consequence: nothing to agree now, and the events needed later may be missing

failureModes.provenBy: the chosen number written in the repository with its definition, and a query that computes it from recorded events

failureModes.prompt: Should the app and the server use the same list of event names?
failureModes.why: when each side names events its own way, one action is counted under two names and the totals do not match

options.label: One shared list of event names
options.consequence: every new event needs an entry first, and both sides count the same way

options.label: Each side names its own events
options.consequence: faster to add events, and the same action appears under different names

failureModes.recommended: One shared list of event names
failureModes.provenBy: a check on every push that each event name sent by the app or the server appears in the shared list

failureModes.prompt: If the app resends an event after a network failure, should it be counted once?
failureModes.why: phones resend events after a dropped connection, and without a check busy days look busier than they were

options.label: Count it once
options.consequence: each event needs its own id, and the numbers stay accurate

options.label: Count every arrival
options.consequence: simplest, and repeated events make the totals too high

failureModes.provenBy: a test that sends the same event twice with one id and asserts the analytics total rises by one
